text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A short while after life on the deserted island began—

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Waaah!! My skin is stinging so bad!
And my hair feels like straw too!

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I spent it waaaay too wildly...!
Compared to that—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...It's like a picture...!

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
There's really no trouble whatsoever...!
I wonder why? How does she take care of it?

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
No, no, there's no way I can go ask...
She's a model, you know? That's way too intimidating...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Nothing.
Well, it happens all the time.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Besides, I haven't done anything special enough to teach.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... Ah, is it already this late?
If I don't go to sleep soon, waking up tomorrow will be a pain—

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ow, ow... The lotion Mom gave me
stings a bit... but it feels like it'll work...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ! H-Hey, that's...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, none of my business, really, but...
Using that lotion right now might be a bad idea.

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that true!?
Was it something bad?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No, the quality is super good.
It's just that it's too strong for sunburnt skin, so it'd actually irritate it.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
First, cool down the skin, then use something
with anti-inflammatory or astringent properties—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, sorry for bringing this up out of nowhere.
Just take it with a grain of salt.

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ......Whoaaa...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Please!
Teach us how to care for them too!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: W-What the? Why am I surrounded...?!

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for your advice yesterday, it really helped!
A model's expertise really is on another level!

text_block_list.name: Twintail Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I got here it's been nothing but trouble!
Please, somebody help me~~!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...I really don't think it's gonna be
as interesting as you're hoping, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
When washing your face in the morning, lather up and stroke gently.
After drying off, moisturize with a mist toner.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
And after this, a sheet mask for extra hydration.
I'll give myself a massage too, depending on my skin.
Finally, I seal it in with lotion or cream—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
On days off, I do roadwork and yoga before breakfast.
It's not good to be completely running on empty, so I make a smoothie to drink.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"It's hard when there are classes,
but on a deserted island, I can do it pretty well."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
First thing when I get back is a shower to wash off the sweat.
Then, breakfast—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Well, that's about the extent of it.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: (Dead silence...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(Oh shoot, did I mess up...?
Was it because I was a letdown...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Well.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: You're way too meticulous...!!

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I feel like I'm gonna quit in three days!
Doing this forever?! Isn't that an insane amount of effort?!

text_block_list.name: Twintail Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
There really is a reason behind being "pretty"...!
Can we even do that?
The bar is insanely high!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Wait, it just takes getting used to!
It's all about getting used to it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those words could no longer reach them—
and afterward on the deserted island, more and more people took on Gold City's routine.
